title.en: Chapter 27 — The Elephant Who Carried Me

book_meta.work: The Seven Voyages of Sindbad, from ألف ليلة وليلة
book_meta.author: traditional

sentences.en: One night, a big elephant came to the tree.
It wrapped its trunk around it and pulled it from the ground.

sentences.ar: وقعت وأنا متأكد إني رح أموت.
sentences.en: I fell, certain that I was going to die.

sentences.ar: بس الفيل شالني بهدوء على ظهره.
sentences.en: But the elephant lifted me gently onto its back.
It walked with me for hours to a far place.
It put me on the ground and left.

sentences.ar: كنت واقف بوسط عظام فيلة كتيرة.
sentences.en: I was standing in the middle of many elephants’ bones.

sentences.ar: فهمت: هاد المحل اللي بيموتوا فيه.
sentences.en: I understood: this is the place where they die.
